# Gather Tomorrow LLC

> Gather Tomorrow LLC is an AI automation consulting firm for small businesses in the US and Taiwan, run by partners Angela and Sam. We help small-business owners and salespeople set up practical AI automations (payment reminders, faster quote replies, lead finding) using tools they already have. Site is English-only for now.

Contact: support@gathertomorrow.com

## Sections

- [Field Notes](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/#notes): plain-language notes on what we're building
- [Tools](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/#tools): small AI tools you can try
- [Case Studies](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/#cases): how it works in practice
- [Book a consultation](https://kuankuan0126-stack.github.io/gathertomorrow-site/#book): tell us what's taking up your time
